 Allison DeGrushe Thu, November 5, 2026 at 10:10 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Travis Kelce Shares New Marriage Update After Report of Taylor Swift’s Wedding ‘Betrayal’ Countless negative reports have emerged since Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce 's star-studded wedding, with some indicating the newlyweds are already " frustrated " in their marriage. That is pure speculation, so take it with a grain of salt. For now, Swift and Kelce appear to be enjoying this next chapter together. In fact, Kelce recently offered a sweet update on their relationship.
 In a recent interview with Women's Wear Daily , the Kansas City Chiefs tight end gushed about spending the holidays with his pop superstar wife. "I'm excited for my first holiday as a married man," he told the outlet while promoting Tommy Hilfiger's winter 2026 holiday campaign, "The Perfect Holiday."

 Taylor Swift Reportedly Determined to 'Hunt Down Culprit' Who 'Sold' Her & Travis Kelce 'Out'-She's 'On Edge' 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Kelce also briefly addressed their plans, saying he loves "all the old traditions and can't wait to start some new ones" with Swift. "I start celebrating as that tree goes up," he added.
 This latest development in Swift and Kelce's marriage follows reports of a major "betrayal." In an October 28 report, celebrity guru Rob Shuter claimed that Swift was left "furious" after The Daily Mail published photos from inside the high-profile couple's wedding at Madison Square Garden in New York City.
 Related: Taylor Swift Reportedly 'Furious' After New Travis Kelce Wedding Photos Leak: It 'Feels Like a Betrayal' 
 "Taylor was furious because this was supposed to be a tightly controlled, private celebration," one source told Naughty But Nice . "Everyone had been told to keep quiet, and the NDAs were there for a reason. She never expected those images to get out."
 Advertisement Advertisement Another insider explained that Swift went to "extraordinary lengths" to protect her and Kelce's privacy, and "a leak like this feels like a betrayal." Now, she's starting to wonder who she can actually trust and "whether anything can truly remain private anymore."
 As of now, it's highly unlikely Swift and Kelce will ever release any official photos from their big day. Talk about devastating .
